tasks.title: Suppress ephemeral credentials in every e2e failure diagnostic and fail closed after collection errors
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy — Behavior (Required behavior 1–7, including Registry, Recording, Consumers, compose cleanup/child replay, standalone setup ownership, failure-logs and CI dev wiring), both documentation changes, all 54 Tests cases (E1–E5, K1–K5, R1, F1–F13, J1–J6, V1, M1, O1, C1–C4, L1–L9, P1–P3, W1–W5), seven console-setup cases and Acceptance 1–11; shared Decisions, Counterexamples, Performance impact and Security impact.

acceptance.command:
bash -euo pipefail -c 'git rev-parse HEAD
bun --version
node --version
for tool in shellcheck jq docker mawk gawk; do command -v "$tool" || true; done
docker compose version'
acceptance.expected: Before the first edit, record/export BASE as the full implementation HEAD SHA and create/export BASE_TREE as an isolated disposable checkout at that SHA, outside the implementation checkout. Inspected base: f7210ec3e9905cf0c3eeaf9d86ad662008578ebf. Bun is 1.4.0; record Node, Compose and awk/lint availability. If BASE moved, rerun all baseline controls and the red proof there; never reuse the old evidence. No plan/note files in deploy.

exit 0 in both revisions; console-setup.test: 7 cases passed (A-G names, stdout literals, token binding/replay and F failure unchanged); runtime-settings.test: 58 cases passed; ok: incident-card; snippet.test: 9 cases passed. The two stdout comparisons are empty. Extended setup tests verify A/B/C/E/G retain a private-mode inherited registry with every independently issued CSRF, form token, password, TOTP, setup key and all ten recovery codes, with no invalid marker; D/F remove their private registry/work directory on success/failure. Existing stdout/stderr secret scans remain.

acceptance.command:
bash -euo pipefail -c ': "${BASE:?recorded full implementation SHA}"
: "${BASE_TREE:?isolated checkout of BASE}"
branch_root=$PWD
red_tree=$(mktemp -d)
trap '\''rm -rf "$red_tree"'\'' EXIT
git clone --quiet --no-hardlinks "$BASE_TREE" "$red_tree/repo"
git -C "$red_tree/repo" checkout --quiet --detach "$BASE"
cp "$branch_root/e2e/redact.test.sh" "$red_tree/repo/e2e/redact.test.sh"
rc=0
(cd "$red_tree/repo" && bash e2e/redact.test.sh) >"$red_tree/result" 2>&1 || rc=$?
cat "$red_tree/result"
test "$rc" = 1
python3 -c '\''import pathlib,re,sys
s=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
for prefix,n in (("K",5),("F",13),("J",6)):
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        lines=re.findall(r"^FAIL: "+prefix+str(i)+r"\b.*$",s,re.M)
        assert lines, (prefix,i,"missing failure")
        assert any("cleanup printed the credential" in x for x in lines) if prefix=="K" else any("sentinel" in x and "output" in x for x in lines), (prefix,i,"not a leak reason")
for case in ["E1","E2","E3","E4","E5","V1","M1","C1","C2","C3","L4"]:
    assert re.search(r"^ok: "+case+r"\b",s,re.M), case
m=re.search(r"redact.test: (\d+) of (54|53) cases failed",s)
assert m and int(m[1])>=24, "incorrect red summary"
assert m[2]==("53" if __import__("os").geteuid()==0 else "54")
print("red proof: all 24 required leak failures and 11 passing controls verified")
'\'' "$red_tree/result"'
acceptance.expected: exit 0 for the proof wrapper; the extended test itself exits 1. All 24 K1-K5/F1-F13/J1-J6 fail for actual printed credentials, including five categories and unregistered quoted JSON cookie keys, rather than missing helpers or syntax errors. E1-E5/V1/M1/C1-C3/L4 pass. Record the exact failure summary (54 cases; 53 only when root skips L7). Other missing-interface failures are not red evidence.

acceptance.command:
bash -euo pipefail -c 'out=$(bash e2e/redact.test.sh 2>&1)
printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$out"
for id in E{1..5} K{1..5} R1 F{1..13} J{1..6} V1 M1 O1 C{1..4} L{1..6} L8 L9 P{1..3} W{1..5}; do
  grep -qE "^ok: $id " <<<"$out"
done
if [[ $(id -u) = 0 ]]; then
  grep -qxF '\''skip: L7 read-only registry (root ignores file modes)'\'' <<<"$out"
  grep -qxF '\''redact.test: 53 cases passed'\'' <<<"$out"
else
  grep -qE '\''^ok: L7 '\'' <<<"$out"
  grep -qxF '\''redact.test: 54 cases passed'\'' <<<"$out"
fi'
acceptance.expected: exit 0; all 54 explicit cases pass (53 and exactly skip: L7 read-only registry (root ignores file modes) as root). Preserve E1-E5. K1-K5 exercise real req/csrf/form_token_args/form_args/totp_after in child shells, not direct registration of all fixtures; deleted/overwritten response files and empty owner_dir cannot hide collection defects. K1 captures four cookie values across two jars/requests, HttpOnly and Set-Cookie, exact status 200; K2 covers independent csrf selection; K3 selected/decoy/runtime tokens; K4 all three generated codes including skipped code; K5 registry contains all ten recovery codes. R1 verifies private modes, silent collectors and 5/6-character boundary. exit 0; F1-F13 then adjacent J1-J6 explicitly prove each sentinel is absent from the valid registry before cleanup. All header, assignment, markup and recovery cases and quoted JSON cookie/set-cookie/pulse_console_session/__Host-/escaped/single-quote cases suppress the credential line and retain plain line. S1-S9 include Authorization and setup code shapes, no awk interval regexes. V1 preserves all 15 literal benign counterexamples; M1 masks repeated literal metacharacters; O1 masks longest first without a suffix; C1-C4 preserve admin, SMTP, runtime service and probe-secret masking. exit 0; L1-L9, P1-P3 and W1-W5 implement every assertion under Tests. L5 uses trap '' XFSZ; ulimit -f 0 with piped output: csrf append fails while the file was readable, returns 1 with credential-free append-failed stderr, creates marker/removes registry, and a later unlimited child cannot recreate it. Invalidity survives processes; cleanup with incoming 0 exits 1, suppresses all logs (including unlabelled unknown sentinels and plain line), and removes the owned directory. L6 tests marker with readable file, L7 permissions, L8 inherited/private setup_exit ordering and statuses, L9 symlink refusal with unchanged target. P2 uses cmp for byte-identical success; P3 suppresses invalid-registry success payload. W1 includes three unregistered J1-J3 cookies and ps/plain line; W2/W3 fail closed with status 1 and stderr; W4 usage exits 2; W5 empty registry masks secrets/fallback and exits 0. Validate combined streams plus FAIL stderr alone. Lifecycle includes empty/missing paths, private modes, inherited-registry replacement, no premature removal and final removal on success/failure.

acceptance.command:
python3 -c 'import os,pathlib,re,subprocess
base=os.environ["BASE"]
p=".github/workflows/ci.yml"
old=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",base+":"+p],text=True)
new=pathlib.Path(p).read_text()
pat=r"(?ms)^  dev:\n.*?(?=^  e2e-dev:)"
a=re.search(pat,old); b=re.search(pat,new)
assert a and b
assert old[:a.start()]+old[a.end():] == new[:b.start()]+new[b.end():], "outside dev changed"
for name in ("uses:","persist-credentials: false"):
    assert [x for x in old.splitlines() if name in x] == [x for x in new.splitlines() if name in x], name
d=b[0]
assert d.count("E2E_NEEDLES: ${{ runner.temp }}/e2e-needles/needles")==2
assert d.count("bash e2e/failure-logs.sh dev/compose.yaml")==1
assert "docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml logs --no-color" not in d
ordered=['\''install -d -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e-needles"'\'','\''install -m 600 /dev/null "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e-needles/needles"'\'',"run: scripts/init-secrets.sh","bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml","bash e2e/failure-logs.sh dev/compose.yaml",'\''rm -rf "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2e-needles"'\'',"docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml down -v --remove-orphans"]
positions=[d.index(x) for x in ordered]
assert positions==sorted(positions) and len(set(positions))==len(positions)
assert d.rfind("uses: actions/checkout")<positions[0]
steps=re.split(r"(?m)^      - ",d)
def step(name):
    found=[x for x in steps if x.startswith("name: "+name+"\n")]
    assert len(found)==1,name
    return found[0]
setup=step("Console setup, sign-in and recreation")
logs=step("Stack state and logs")
teardown=step("Teardown")
assert "E2E_NEEDLES: ${{ runner.temp }}/e2e-needles/needles" in setup
assert "E2E_NEEDLES: ${{ runner.temp }}/e2e-needles/needles" in logs
assert "if: failure()" in logs and "bash e2e/failure-logs.sh dev/compose.yaml" in logs
assert "if: always()" in teardown and ordered[-2] in teardown and ordered[-1] in teardown
print("CI dev wiring: pass")
'
acceptance.expected: exit 0; CI dev wiring: pass. Only dev changes; all actions/pins/checkout settings and other jobs remain identical to BASE. Mode-700/600 registry creation follows six checkouts and precedes init/start; setup and failure helper share env exactly twice; failure() and always() remain; final removal follows diagnostics and precedes existing down.

acceptance.command:
python3 -c 'import os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
base=pathlib.Path(os.environ["BASE_TREE"]).resolve()
branch=pathlib.Path.cwd()
scripts=["e2e/redact.test.sh","e2e/console-setup.test.sh","e2e/runtime-settings.test.sh"]
samples={s:[] for s in scripts}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="pulse-870-cpu-") as tmp:
    for label,tree in [("base",base),("branch",branch),("base",base),("branch",branch)]:
        for s in scripts:
            timing=pathlib.Path(tmp)/"cpu"
            r=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/time","-f","%U %S","-o",str(timing),"bash",s],cwd=tree,text=True,capture_output=True)
            assert r.returncode==0,(label,s,"control failed; do not report green")
            user,system=map(float,timing.read_text().split())
            samples[s].append(user+system)
            summary=(r.stdout+r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-1]
            print(label,s,"user",user,"system",system,"cpu",user+system,summary,flush=True)
for s,x in samples.items():
    bm=(x[0]+x[2])/2
    hm=(x[1]+x[3])/2
    print(s,"base_mean",bm,"branch_mean",hm,"delta",hm-bm)
'
acceptance.expected: All 12 timed control runs pass, interleaved base/branch/base/branch using identical script commands, fixtures and pinned tooling. Report four user/system CPU samples per suite, both arithmetic means and branch-minus-base delta. Redact is reported separately (5 -> 54 cases, 53 as root) as regression-only cost; setup remains 7 and runtime remains 58. Discuss shared-machine noise, never gate on wall time; no numeric performance threshold or budget change, no Docker bench (#834).
